inference.quality_and_costs: reported separately; no conversion of prediction loss into compute units

final_counterfactual.wrong_acceptance: final after-program loss > before-program loss + minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.wrong_rejection: final rejected-program loss < restored-program loss - minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.denominators: scored revise and rollback events respectively; missing AST records remain separate
final_counterfactual.scope: only alternatives actually involved in recorded decisions; final labels never enter learning

limitations: Development, confirmation, forward and continual are development evidence for this version.
Stateful is a public synthetic prospective partition; using its results to change learning turns it into development evidence.
Stateful evaluates history lengths beyond the maximum acquired trajectory; history bins distinguish early and longer-horizon predictions.
State classification measures predictions on known binary-output tasks; it does not identify the agent's latent concepts or prove mechanism recovery.
Three suite seeds produce coarse bootstrap intervals; failures and unknown costs remain explicit.
Only the first seed retains up to three v4 and three v5 case traces, selected after evaluation by prediction and risk loss.
Compute units and learning wall time remain separate; final counterfactual evaluation has its own cost and never updates learning.

design.pairing: same suite seed, initial and catalog probes, final evaluation and budget caps; adaptive queries may differ
design.stateful_horizons: maximum training probe length 32; eight independent final trajectories of length 64
design.classification: prediction threshold fixed at 0.5 for evaluator-labeled binary state tasks; report all-row and transition errors
design.reference_stateful_adapter: saved v4 config uses continual label; stateful environment values are converted to the saved Observation type

inference.quality_and_costs: reported separately; no conversion of prediction loss into compute units

final_counterfactual.wrong_acceptance: final after-program loss > before-program loss + minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.wrong_rejection: final rejected-program loss < restored-program loss - minimum_improvement
final_counterfactual.denominators: scored revise and rollback events respectively; missing AST records remain separate
final_counterfactual.scope: only alternatives actually involved in recorded decisions; final labels never enter learning

limitations: Development, confirmation, forward and continual are development evidence for this version.
Stateful is a public synthetic prospective partition; using its results to change learning turns it into development evidence.
Stateful evaluates history lengths beyond the maximum acquired trajectory; history bins distinguish early and longer-horizon predictions.
State classification measures predictions on known binary-output tasks; it does not identify the agent's latent concepts or prove mechanism recovery.
Three suite seeds produce coarse bootstrap intervals; failures and unknown costs remain explicit.
Only the first seed retains up to three v4 and three v5 case traces, selected after evaluation by prediction and risk loss.
Compute units and learning wall time remain separate; final counterfactual evaluation has its own cost and never updates learning.

design.pairing: same suite seed, initial and catalog probes, final evaluation and budget caps; adaptive queries may differ
design.stateful_horizons: maximum training probe length 32; eight independent final trajectories of length 64
design.classification: prediction threshold fixed at 0.5 for evaluator-labeled binary state tasks; report all-row and transition errors
design.reference_stateful_adapter: saved v4 config uses continual label; stateful environment values are converted to the saved Observation type
